projects.title: Deep Learning to Examine Prostate Cancer and Pneumonia
projects.description:
Studied modern deep learning techniques and concepts of convolutional neural networks (CNN) for medical imaging
Programmed primarily in Tensorflow/Keras using Python to design, train, and validate neural networks 
Used different CNN architectures to identify abnormalities in the prostate gland by processing data provided by the UCI Medical Center and Kaggle

organizations.name: Antleader Mentorship Program (AMP)
organizations.description:
AMP is a student-led mentorship program that serves to help ease the transition to university for 1st-generation, low-socioeconomic identifying 1st years by providing one-on-one mentorship, workshops, and connecting 1st years to a network of students from different majors as well as both on- and off-campus involvements. 
I am involved with organizing, hosting, and documenting events and workshops for large groups of undergraduate students, with the intent of helping students navigate their academic, professional, and personal experience here at UCI.
